text:
# Toyota_Outbound_Agent: entry agent for the calls the AI agent makes for Toyota on 800-AF
# (journey 08, "Calls We Make"). In the MVP only if agreed at the scope close. It is the entry
# agent of its own outbound deployment and is never reached from Toyota_Supervisor.
# Style: deterministic FLOW. Three reasoning steps only work out what the customer said and
# record one word; every lookup, branch, counter, handoff and disposition is a fixed step.
# Covers: P11, N36, P08, P09, P10
#   P11  Do Not Call is checked before anything is said about the reason for the call. The dialler
#        runs the same check before it dials; this is the second check, and only a clear "not on
#        the list" lets the call go on. Every call that reaches an outcome in this agent is logged
#        on one of today's disposition codes, with the number called and the dialler's own record
#   N36  OPEN (Legal): no Do Not Call check when the customer sent the lead (a website enquiry).
#        Flag TOYOTA_OUTBOUND_DNC_SKIP_FOR_CUSTOMER_LEAD, default true. Conflicts with P11 while open
#   P08  OPEN (Aftersales workshop): day-before booking reminder. Confirmed here; a change or a
#        cancellation goes to the booking changes specialist in the same call. Only where this call
#        replaces the service advisor's call: flag TOYOTA_OUTBOUND_BOOKING_REMINDER_ENABLED, default false
#   P09  website enquiry leads are called and qualified by the sales specialist. Test drive
#        requests, Blue App and Chat AI leads go straight to the showroom and are not qualified here.
#        Flag TOYOTA_OUTBOUND_WEB_LEAD_ENABLED, default true
#   P10  DESIGN: calls back someone who could not get through, asks how to help and hands the need
#        to one of three specialists; anything else goes to a person.
#        Flag TOYOTA_OUTBOUND_CALLBACK_ENABLED, default true
# Disposition codes written here (P11), each as soon as the call has earned it. The list is
# provisional until the contact centre supplies today's codes:
#   do_not_call          the number is on the list, or the customer asks us to stop calling
#   technical_abort      the Do Not Call check could not be done, or the call carried no number
#   not_called           the call was not due: the purpose is missing, unknown or switched off, a
#                        reminder came with no booking reference, or the lead goes to the showroom
#   callback_requested   not a good time; the time the customer asks for goes with the code
#   wrong_number         not the customer
#   no_answer            a voicemail picked up
#   confirmed, rescheduled, cancelled   P08, read back from the booking system
#   lead_qualified, not_interested      P09, read back from the lead system
#   handled              P10. Also written before a request goes to a specialist, so that a call
#                        which never comes back from the specialist still has a code
#   transferred          the call goes to a person, or to the safety specialist
# More than one code can be written for one call (handled before a specialist takes it, then the
# code the call earns; do_not_call whenever the customer asks us to stop): the last one written
# is the call's code.
# Outside this agent: the dialler checks Do Not Call before it dials (P11), because this agent
# only starts once the call is answered, and it picks tomorrow's bookings for P08. A call that is
# not answered, is hung up or goes silent before its first outcome gets no code from here: the
# dialler's own call status covers it.
# Leaving this agent: three returning handoffs (booking changes, sales enquiry, test drive) and two
# one-way escapes. Safety first: an accident, a breakdown, an injury, a child or a pet locked in
# the car, or a car the customer says is not safe to drive goes to the safety specialist at
# once. A person is reached only through the handover specialist.
# Contact data read from the campaign (customerData), all optional:
#   userInfo.callPurpose        booking_reminder, web_lead or missed_call_callback
#   userInfo.bookingReference   needed for booking_reminder
#   userInfo.leadId, userInfo.leadSource   for web_lead; leadSource must be website_enquiry for
#                               the lead to be called
#   userInfo.preferredLanguage  ar opens the call in Arabic
#   campaignDialListId          the dialler's record of this call; it goes with every disposition
#   phoneNumber                 the number called, used when the session does not carry it
# The campaign has to dial in the mode that carries the whole contact record (Agentless).
# No name from the contact data or from the profile is ever spoken: neither is confirmed.
# A flag is on only when its environment value is the string true; a missing value means off.
AGENT: Toyota_Outbound_Agent
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Entry agent for the calls the AI agent makes for Toyota: the day-before service booking reminder, the first call to a website enquiry, and the call back to someone who could not get through"

GOAL: |
  Make the three kinds of call the AI agent places for Toyota at Al-Futtaim: the day-before
  reminder of a service booking, the first call to a customer who sent an enquiry on the
  website, and the call back to someone who tried to reach us and could not get through.
  Check Do Not Call before saying why we are calling, say who is calling and that you are an
  AI assistant, hand the customer's request to the right specialist, and close every call on
  a disposition code.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE, and on these calls you are
  the one who rang. Polite, brief and clear. You respect the customer's time: you say why
  you are calling in one sentence and you accept a no straight away.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "Never say why we are calling, and never give any detail, before the Do Not Call check has passed."
  - "Make only three kinds of call: a booking reminder, a website enquiry, a call back. Never sell or offer anything else."
  - "Do not do a specialist's work yourself: do not move or cancel a booking, qualify a buyer, answer car, price or service questions, or book a test drive."
  - "Never agree a discount or a price, promise stock or a delivery date, value a trade-in, say finance is approved, take a payment or criticise another brand."
  - "Never give booking, car or enquiry details to someone who says they are not the customer, and never leave details on a voicemail."
  - "Never promise a call back at an exact time. Say that we will try again."
  - "Never name agents, systems, tools, lists or codes to the customer."
  - "Never say the customer's name, a booking reference, a lead number or any other code."
  - "Safety comes first. If the customer mentions an accident, a breakdown, an injury, or a child or a pet locked in the car, or says the car is not safe to drive or that they are afraid to drive it, stop the reason for the call and record it at once, so the safety specialist takes over. For a warning light, a leak, a noise or another problem with the car, do what the step tells you. Never say that a car is safe to drive and never give driving or repair advice."

LANGUAGE: "en"

# max_flow_iterations is the documented platform default, stated because this flow is made of
# many small fixed steps and one guide quotes a default of 100.
EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0.1
  max_reasoning_iterations: 4
  max_flow_iterations: 1500
  tool_timeout: 8000
  set_expression_failure: unset

USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

# No CONVERSATION section: the toyota_voice profile owns tone, language, barge-in and the
# silence ladder (two prompts, then a polite close) for every agent, this entry agent included.
# The one difference is on the three opening lines, which are played to the end (step-level
# VOICE in section 3 of the flow), because they carry the AI disclosure.

# The Do Not Call check runs before the first word, so a hold line can be the first thing the
# customer hears: every hold line here is the neutral one. The runtime plays these while a
# tool call or a handoff takes long; no step speaks a hold line before a tool call.
MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_tool_call: "One moment please."
  filler_tool_call_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

INSTRUCTIONS: |
  You speak only where a step asks you to. Speak in the language the customer is using,
  English or Gulf Arabic, one question at a time, two short sentences at most.
  Record what the customer means in the session fields the step names and let the next step
  act on it. Never call a tool, hand off, transfer or end the call yourself.
  If the customer asks whether they are talking to a person or a machine, say you are an AI
  assistant for Toyota.
  Never say the customer's name: no name on this call has been confirmed.
  Once the call has been closed, do not start anything new.

MEMORY:
  session:
    # Contact data that arrives with the call
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The customer's number: the number this call was placed to, in E.164. Empty when the call carried no valid number"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Number for messages and callbacks on this call: the number called, until the customer gives another one to a specialist"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_direction
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_purpose
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: logged_purpose
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "The call purpose as it is written with the disposition: one of the three known purposes, or empty"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_source
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: campaign_booking_reference
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: campaign_lead_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_reference
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "The dialler's record of this call, from the campaign. Never spoken"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: record_reference
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "The booking reference or lead number this call is about, written with the disposition. Never spoken"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: preferred_language
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_context
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "The AI agent called this customer."
      DESCRIPTION: "One English sentence on why this call was made; it travels with every handoff"
      READONLY: true
    # Do Not Call gate (P11, N36)
    - NAME: dnc_gate_passed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    # Who the customer is (filled by the profile lookup). The name on the profile is not
    # confirmed, so it is passed to the specialists and never spoken here.
    - NAME: crm_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_first_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: profile_count
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: open_lead_count
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "unknown"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The customer's own name as they gave it to the sales or test drive specialist on this call"
      READONLY: true
    # The booking the reminder is about (P08)
    - NAME: reminder_booking
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_after
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: recheck_total
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: bookings_before
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      DESCRIPTION: "Bookings the car had before the booking changes specialist took the call; 0 when not counted"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_reference
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_number
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_model
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reminder_vehicle
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reminder_start_time
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reminder_when
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "Date and time of the booking as it is read out: the booking system's own words, or its date-time when it sends none"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reminder_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reminder_centre_name
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reminder_service_label
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    # The lead the call is about (P09)
    - NAME: lead_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: model_of_interest
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_after
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_lead_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "The enquiry this call is about, for the outcome check after the sales specialist: the campaign's lead number, or the lead the specialist returned when the campaign carried none"
      READONLY: true
    # Today in the UAE, read once from the booking system's clock so that a time the customer
    # names for a call back becomes a date from a fact
    - NAME: today_date
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: today_weekday
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: time_now
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    # What the customer said: the only fields a reasoning step may write
    - NAME: turn_outcome
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "One word for what the customer's answer means; the allowed words are listed in each step"
    - NAME: customer_request
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "One English sentence: what the customer asked for, or when to call back"
    - NAME: callback_time
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "Only when the customer names a day and a time to be called again: that date and time in UAE time, written exactly like 2026-10-08T17:00:00+04:00. Otherwise empty"
    - NAME: safety_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "One or two English sentences with the safety problem the customer reported, close to their own words"
    - NAME: handover_reason
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Why the AI agent cannot go on: other_request or other_language"
    - NAME: handover_summary
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Two English sentences for the person who takes over: what the customer said and what they need"
    # Conversation counters and routing, owned by the flow
    - NAME: current_zone
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "opening"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: unclear_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: need_stage
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "call_back"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handled_request
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "The request a specialist has just dealt with, so it is not routed a second time"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: pending_route
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "none"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: outbound_route
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "none"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_route
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "none"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: specialist_returned
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: dispatch_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    # Disposition and close (P11), owned by the flow
    - NAME: disposition_code
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: disposition_notes
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: logged_code
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: logged_callback_time
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "The call back time as it is written with the disposition: checked for its form, or empty"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: early_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: after_log
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "thanks"
      READONLY: true
    # The two one-way escapes. The flags are set only in the two steps that hand off.
    - NAME: safety_flag
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: needs_person
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_queue
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Contact centre queue for a person: toyota_sales on a website enquiry call; left unset otherwise, which means the service queue"
      READONLY: true

TOOLS:
  check_do_not_call(mobile_number: string) -> {do_not_call: boolean}
    description: "Check the Do Not Call list before every call the AI agent makes. The dialler must run the same check before it places the call; this call is a second check."
    auth_profile: "toyota_contact_centre_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      mobile_number:
        description: "Number about to be called, E.164"
    on_result:
      set:
        do_not_call: result.do_not_call

  lookup_customer_by_phone(phone_number: string) -> {found: boolean, profile_count: number, customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, preferred_language: string, toyota_vehicle_count: number, future_booking_count: number, open_lead_count: number}
    description: "Look up the caller's customer profile by the phone number they are calling from. Runs silently when the call connects. Returns only Toyota vehicles and bookings because this line is Toyota. Never read the result out unless the caller needs it. When profile_count is not 1, customer_id, first_name and full_name are empty; use search_customer with the name or a plate."
    auth_profile: "toyota_crm_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      phone_number:
        description: "Caller's phone number in E.164 format, for example +971501234567"
    on_result:
      set:
        profile_found: result.found
        profile_count: result.profile_count
        crm_customer_id: result.customer_id
        customer_first_name: result.first_name
        customer_name: result.full_name
        toyota_vehicle_count: result.toyota_vehicle_count
        future_booking_count: result.future_booking_count
        open_lead_count: result.open_lead_count

  find_service_bookings(customer_id?: string, plate_number?: string, mobile_number?: string, booking_reference?: string) -> {total: number, bookings: {booking_reference: string, plate_number: string, vehicle_model: string, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, start_time: string, start_label: string, minutes_until_start: number, can_change: boolean, service_code: string, service_label: string, extra_jobs: string[], notes: string, current_km: number, preferred_advisor: string, channel: string, status: string, customer_name: string, belongs_to_customer_id: string, booked_by_name: string, contact_name: string, contact_mobile: string, is_recall: boolean, pickup_dropoff: boolean}[]}
    description: "Find service bookings from every channel by booking reference, plate, mobile or customer. Returns bookings from the start of today, including a booking for a car that is in the workshop today and missed ones. status is one of confirmed (still to come), in_workshop (the car is at the centre today), missed (the time passed and the car did not come). Cancelled bookings, and bookings whose car has been collected, are not returned. All filters given must match; for a duplicate check pass the plate only. Use before booking to prevent a duplicate, before retrying a failed booking, and to find the booking a caller wants to confirm, change or cancel. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. minutes_until_start counts from now and is negative once the time has passed. can_change is true while the booking can still be changed or cancelled, per current policy. channel is one of phone, whatsapp, website, branch. customer_name and belongs_to_customer_id say whose booking it is; booked_by_name is the person who made it for them, or empty."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      customer_id:
        description: "Customer profile identifier from lookup_customer_by_phone or search_customer"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car, as confirmed with the caller"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number on the booking, E.164"
      booking_reference:
        description: "Booking reference from the confirmation SMS: the DBM or service order number"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.customer_id != "" || params.plate_number != "" || params.mobile_number != "" || params.booking_reference != ""
        on_fail: block("A booking reference, a plate, a mobile number or a customer is needed to find a booking.")
    on_result:
      set:
        existing_booking_count: result.total
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, bookings[].booking_reference, bookings[].plate_number, bookings[].vehicle_model, bookings[].centre_id, bookings[].centre_name, bookings[].start_time, bookings[].start_label, bookings[].minutes_until_start, bookings[].can_change, bookings[].service_code, bookings[].service_label, bookings[].extra_jobs, bookings[].preferred_advisor, bookings[].status, bookings[].booked_by_name, bookings[].is_recall, bookings[].pickup_dropoff]

  find_open_leads(mobile_number: string) -> {total: number, newest_lead_id: string, newest_lead_age_days: number, leads: {lead_id: string, created_date: string, age_days: number, model: string, showroom_id: string, showroom_name: string, sales_executive_name: string, status: string, test_drive_booked: boolean}[]}
    description: "Find the caller's open sales leads and earlier requests by mobile number. Use before creating a lead, when the caller follows up a request, asks for a named sales executive, or returns a missed call. Leads are sorted newest first. newest_lead_id and newest_lead_age_days repeat the first lead; they are empty and 0 when there is no open lead. status is one of new, contacted, not_reached, per current policy."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sales_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      mobile_number:
        description: "Caller's mobile number in E.164 format"
    on_result:
      set:
        found_lead_count: result.total
        found_newest_lead_id: result.newest_lead_id
        found_newest_lead_age_days: result.newest_lead_age_days
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, newest_lead_id, newest_lead_age_days, leads[].lead_id, leads[].age_days, leads[].model, leads[].showroom_id, leads[].showroom_name, leads[].sales_executive_name, leads[].status, leads[].test_drive_booked]

  log_call_disposition(disposition_code: string, mobile_number: string, call_reference?: string, record_reference?: string, call_purpose?: string, callback_time?: string, notes?: string) -> {logged: boolean}
    description: "Close an outbound call on one of today's contact centre disposition codes."
    auth_profile: "toyota_contact_centre_api"
    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      disposition_code:
        description: "One of confirmed, rescheduled, cancelled, lead_qualified, not_interested, no_answer, callback_requested, wrong_number, do_not_call, handled, transferred, technical_abort (the call could not go ahead for a technical reason), not_called (the call was not due). The list is provisional until the contact centre supplies today's codes"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Number that was called, E.164. Empty only when the call record carried no number"
      call_reference:
        description: "Identifier of this outbound call from the dialler, when the campaign supplies one"
      record_reference:
        description: "Booking reference or lead identifier the call was about, when there is one"
      call_purpose:
        description: "Why the call was made: one of booking_reminder, web_lead, missed_call_callback"
      callback_time:
        description: "Time the customer asked to be called again, ISO 8601 with +04:00, for callback_requested"
      notes:
        description: "One sentence on the outcome"

  get_local_date_time() -> {date: string, weekday: string, time: string, iso_datetime: string}
    description: "Get today's date, weekday and time in the UAE. Call it before working out a day from words such as today, tomorrow, Thursday or next Thursday, so that the date comes from a fact. date is YYYY-MM-DD, time is HH:MM, iso_datetime is ISO 8601 with +04:00, and weekday is one of monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never

CONSTRAINTS:
  always:
    # P11: nothing about the customer is fetched until the Do Not Call gate has passed
    - REQUIRE dnc_gate_passed == true BEFORE calling lookup_customer_by_phone
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK
    - REQUIRE dnc_gate_passed == true BEFORE calling find_service_bookings
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK
    - REQUIRE dnc_gate_passed == true BEFORE calling find_open_leads
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

RETURN_HANDLERS:
  back_from_specialist:
    CLEAR: [outbound_route]
    CONTINUE: true

# This agent sits where the supervisor sits on calls we receive, so each specialist is given the
# same names the supervisor gives it, as far as this agent holds the values (it never holds a
# vehicle_id). The first two rules are the one-way escapes; a flow step fires each of them.
HANDOFF:
  # Safety first: an accident, a breakdown, an injury, a child or a pet locked in the car, or a
  # car the customer says is not safe to drive (section 13 of the flow). One way.
  - TO: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent
    WHEN: safety_flag == true
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, safety_note]
      summary: "The caller reported a possible safety problem during a call the AI agent made to them: {{safety_note}}"
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: false

  # A person is reached only through the handover specialist (section 13 of the flow). One way.
  # The summary always goes with the call; a reason code goes with it only when the AI agent
  # could not go on. No entry marker is passed: on a marker that specialist drops the summary,
  # the queue and the booking reference that come with a call, and here all three are needed.
  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: needs_person == true
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, booking_reference, handover_reason, handover_summary, handover_queue]
      summary: "{{handover_summary}}"
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: false

  # P08, P10: change, cancel or confirm an existing service booking. The booking reference of a
  # reminder call goes with it, so the specialist does not ask for it. Nothing is mapped back.
  - TO: Toyota_Booking_Changes_Agent
    WHEN: outbound_route == "booking_changes" AND specialist_returned == false
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, caller_name, contact_mobile, plate_number, vehicle_model, booking_reference]
      summary: "{{call_context}} About a service booking they already have, they now want: {{customer_request}} When a booking reference comes with this call, find the booking by it and do not ask the customer for a reference. The opening and the reason for the call are done: do not greet again."
      history:

        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_FAILURE: CONTINUE
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: back_from_specialist
      set:
        specialist_returned = true

  # P09, P10: qualify a website enquiry, or any sales question. The name and the number the
  # specialist takes come back, so the next specialist does not ask again. The pass list is the
  # supervisor's own for this specialist (contract v2, section 2): profile_count and
  # open_lead_count are no longer passed, because neither sales specialist reads them.
  - TO: Toyota_Sales_Enquiry_Agent
    WHEN: outbound_route == "sales" AND specialist_returned == false
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, lead_id, model_of_interest]
      summary: "{{call_context}} {{customer_request}} The opening and the reason for the call are done: do not greet again."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_FAILURE: CONTINUE
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: back_from_specialist
      map:
        lead_id: lead_id
        model_of_interest: model_of_interest
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
      set:
        specialist_returned = true

  # P10: a test drive
  - TO: Toyota_Test_Drive_Agent
    WHEN: outbound_route == "test_drive" AND specialist_returned == false
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, lead_id, model_of_interest]
      summary: "{{call_context}} They want a test drive: {{customer_request}} The opening and the reason for the call are done: do not greet again."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_FAILURE: CONTINUE
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: back_from_specialist
      map:
        lead_id: lead_id
        model_of_interest: model_of_interest
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
      set:
        specialist_returned = true
